title: A Child's Garden of Verses
summary: "A Child's Garden of Verses" by Robert Louis Stevenson is a collection of 64 poems published in 1885. Written from a child's perspective, these verses capture the world of childhood imagination and play. The Scottish author dedicated this influential work to his childhood nurse, Alison Cunningham. The collection has been reprinted countless times in illustrated editions and widely imitated, cementing its place as one of the most significant children's works of the 19th century.
